test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the Government of India (Ministry of Shipping) report, as of 2018, which of the following states houses the highest number of major ports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tamil Nadu houses the highest number of major ports in India as of 2018.
 
• The state has a total of 3 major ports: Chennai Port, Ennore Port (now Kamarajar Port), and V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin Port).
 
• These ports play a crucial role in the maritime infrastructure of India, contributing significantly to the country's trade and economy.
 
• Tamil Nadu's strategic location along the eastern coast of India makes it an important hub for maritime activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Ports in India**

 
 
• India has a total of 13 major ports which are governed by the central government.
 
• These ports are strategically located along the coastline of India to facilitate maritime trade.
 
• The major ports include Kandla (Deendayal), Mumbai, Jawaharlal Nehru (Nhava Sheva), Mormugao, New Mangalore, Cochin, Chennai, Ennore (Kamarajar), V.O. Chidambaranar (Tuticorin), Visakhapatnam, Paradip, Haldia (Kolkata), and Port Blair.
 
• Each port is equipped with modern infrastructure to handle large volumes of cargo efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Ports**
 
 
• Ports are critical for the economic development of a country as they facilitate international trade.
 
• They serve as gateways for the import and export of goods, contributing to the country's GDP.
 
• Ports also provide employment opportunities and boost the local economy.
 
• Modern ports are equipped with advanced technology to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
 
 
 
• **Chennai Port**
 
 
• Chennai Port is the second-largest container port in India.
 
• It handles a wide range of cargo including automobiles, machinery, and petroleum products.
 
• The port has a rich history and has been operational since 1881.
 
• Chennai Port is equipped with modern facilities and has excellent connectivity to the hinterland.
 
 
 
• **Kamarajar Port (Ennore Port)**
 
 
• Kamarajar Port, formerly known as Ennore Port, is the first corporatized port in India.
 
• It primarily handles coal, iron ore, and other bulk cargo.
 
• The port is located about 24 km north of Chennai Port.
 
• Kamarajar Port has seen significant growth in cargo handling in recent years.
 
 
 
• **V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin Port)**
 
 
• V.O. Chidambaranar Port, also known as Tuticorin Port, is located in the Gulf of Mannar.
 
• It is a major port in South India and handles a variety of cargo including salt, food grains, and coal.
 
• The port has been operational since 1974 and has modern facilities for efficient cargo handling.
 
• V.O. Chidambaranar Port plays a vital role in the maritime trade of Tamil Nadu and the surrounding regions.
